TOPIC 1.14
Connecting Infinite 
Limits and Vertical 
Asymptotes

SUGGESTED SKILLS

Justification

3.D
Apply an appropriate 
mathematical definition, 
theorem, or test.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

LIM-2.D
Interpret the behavior 
of functions using limits 
involving infinity.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

LIM-2.D.1
The concept of a limit can be extended to 
include infinite limits.

LIM-2.D.2
Asymptotic and unbounded behavior of functions 
can be described and explained using limits.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

LIM-2
Reasoning with definitions, theorems, and properties can be used to justify claims 
about continuity.
